name: Ceres
tagline: The first asteroid ever found — a dwarf planet holding a third of the belt's mass.
history: Giuseppe Piazzi discovered Ceres on New Year's Day 1801 — the first object ever found in the gap between Mars and Jupiter, later understood to be the largest member of the asteroid belt containing about a third of its total mass. The IAU upgraded it to dwarf-planet status in 2006 alongside Pluto's demotion. NASA's Dawn spacecraft orbited it from 2015 to 2018 — the first dwarf planet ever visited — and found the famous bright spots of Occator Crater to be sodium-carbonate salts left by briny water percolating up from a frozen subsurface layer, evidence Ceres was once an ocean world.
